Administrative Support

Support Second Harvest with general administration, which can include: data entry, research, calling campaigns, outreach and more. Opportunities exist across Canada through virtual volunteering or can be based out of our Headquarters in Toronto, ON. Shift times are flexible

Community Champion

Become a leadership volunteer that networks and represents Second Harvest in local communities across Canada. Duties can include: facilitating education sessions, attending local events, speaking engagements, managing projects and volunteers. This role requires a minimum 6-month commitment. Shift times are flexible.

Event Support

Help Second Harvest at a variety of community events across Canada. Activities can include building brand awareness, running fun and informative activities, selling tickets, registration, set up/tear down and more. Volunteers must be 19+ years of age. Shift times may vary by event.

Seasonal

Feeding Our Future

The Feeding Our Future program reaches children that do not always have access to healthy food in the summer months. Volunteers help prepare lunches for delivery to children attending summer camps across Toronto in July and August.  Shift times: 3-4 hours Mondays through Thursdays..

Group

Year-Round

Food Sorts

Food Sorts offer a unique opportunity for groups of 5–50 people to help prepare and pack donated food for delivery to non-profits across the Greater Toronto Area. Teams will learn about the impact of community involvement while helping ensure Second Harvest partners receive vital food donations. A 1-hour education session can also be added to this experience.

To request a food sort for your group, please complete the Group Food Sort Request Form.

Year-Round

Food Sort Team Leader

Provide leadership support by facilitating group food sorts and ensuring volunteers have an engaging and educational experience while visiting Second Harvest Headquarters in Toronto, ON. Shift times: 3 hours Tuesdays through Thursdays.

Group

Helping Hands For The Holidays

A Helping Hands Food Sort includes repacking and sorting vital food donations along with a variety of holiday-themed activities, snacks, games and an ugly holiday sweater contest. This event is based in Toronto, ON and takes place on the first two Mondays in December.

A creative team-building opportunity that is delivered to you! Write thoughtful messages to accompany food delivered to agencies with youth programming. Ideal for group sizes of 10-25 people and takes place year-round at any workplace across Canada.

FAQ

How do I APPLY to be a volunteer?
Volunteering

Ready to join our food rescue mission? Applying is a breeze! Visit our website, fill out a simple form and we'll connect with you to provide all the details you need to kick off your volunteering journey. It's that easy. Let's make a positive impact together. Apply now!

What Are The Requirements I Need to Meet To Become A Volunteer?
Volunteering

For many of our positions, all you need is enthusiasm, a passion for reducing food waste and a willingness to help others. Minimum age requirements may apply for opportunities at events, on our trucks and in our warehouse.

DOES SECOND HARVEST OFFER VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES ACROSS CANADA?
Volunteering

Yes, Second Harvest does have volunteer opportunities available at various times of the year throughout Canada. While many of our in-person volunteer activities take place at our headquarters in Toronto, we are always adding new opportunities and encourage anyone interested in representing us from coast to coast to coast to join our national volunteer roster.

Why volunteer at Second Harvest?
Volunteering

Join our vibrant team, connect with fellow volunteers and witness the immediate impact of redirecting surplus food to those in need. Second Harvest volunteers play a crucial role in reducing food waste and fostering a sense of community. Join us for an enriching experience where your time makes a meaningful difference.

I submitted a volunteer application, when can I expect to volunteer?
Volunteering

All volunteer applications are reviewed and applicants whose skills, interests and availability best match the requirements of our current volunteer positions will be contacted by a member of the Volunteer Program Team.

Do I need a Vulnerable Sector Check to volunteer?
Volunteering

Currently, Second Harvest does not require a Vulnerable Sector Check to volunteer.

I need to fulfill court-appointed hours. Can I volunteer at Second Harvest?
Volunteering

Second Harvest does not accept court-appointed volunteers. Due to the high volume of applicants, we give priority to volunteers who are seeking an ongoing commitment with Second Harvest.

Do you have evening and weekend volunteer opportunities?
Volunteering

Yes, many of our events take place in the evening or on weekends. Check our individual volunteer opportunities or group volunteer opportunities.

How can I stay informed of upcoming volunteer opportunities?
Volunteering

The best ways to learn about volunteer opportunities are to join our applicant list, attend a Volunteer Information Session and subscribe to our monthly newsletter, The Harvest Journal. You can subscribe to it at the bottom of this page. You can also follow us on social media and check in regularly on our website.

Can I just drop-in to volunteer?
Volunteering

No, all volunteers, including corporate and community groups are required to book in advance of volunteering with Second Harvest.

I'm a high school student and need volunteer hours to graduate. What opportunities do you have for students?
Volunteering

Volunteer opportunities for students include helping our drivers distribute rescued food, warehouse support and more. Students must be a minimum age of 16 years old to volunteer with Second Harvest.

Our company's employees would like to volunteer together. Can we do this?
Volunteering

Of course! Second Harvest offers a variety of meaningful opportunities for corporate teams to get involved. Please view our corporate opportunities listed above to learn about our year-round activities and contact volunteer@secondharvest.ca to book the team-building experience of your choice.

Will volunteering lead to employment at Second Harvest?
Volunteering

Volunteer experience will always enhance a resume but volunteering at Second Harvest does not guarantee a paid position at our organization. You can check our Careers page for employment opportunities and requirements for paid positions.

Questions?

Have questions about our volunteer program? Reach out to us!
